	mID int primary key, 
	title text, 
	year int, 
	director text
);

	rID int, 
	mID int, 
	stars int, 
	ratingDate date,
	FOREIGN KEY (mID) references Movie(mID),

);

{"question": "Quels sont le nom du critique, le titre du film, la note du film et la date de la note pour chaque film, triés par nom du critique, par titre du film, puis enfin par note ?", "schema": "CREATE TABLE Movie(
	mID int primary key, 
	title text, 
	year int, 
	director text
);

CREATE TABLE Rating(
	rID int, 
	mID int, 
	stars int, 
	ratingDate date,
	FOREIGN KEY (mID) references Movie(mID),
	FOREIGN KEY (rID) references Reviewer(rID)
);

CREATE TABLE Reviewer(
	rID int primary key, 
	name text);"}
SELECT T3.name, T2.title, T1.stars, T1.ratingDate FROM Rating AS T1 JOIN Movie AS T2 ON T1.mID = T2.mID JOIN Reviewer AS T3 ON T1.rID = T3.rID ORDER BY T3.name, T2.title, T1.stars

{"question": "Combien de produits avons-nous ?", "schema": "CREATE TABLE `Addresses` (

);

FROM Students AS s
WHERE s.student_id IN (
    SELECT student_id
    FROM Classes
    GROUP BY student_id
    HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2
)

    SELECT student_id
    FROM Detention
    GROUP BY student_id
    HAVING COUNT(*) < 2
);

WITH frequencies AS (
    SELECT behaviour_monitoring_details, COUNT(*) AS frequency
    FROM Behaviour_Monitoring
    GROUP BY behaviour_monitoring_details
),
most_frequent AS (
    SELECT MAX(frequency) AS max_frequency
    FROM frequencies
),
student_results AS (
    SELECT student_id, COUNT(*) AS total_records,
           SUM(CASE WHEN f.frequency = mf.max_frequency THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS matching_records
    FROM Behaviour_Monitoring bm
    JOIN frequencies f ON bm.behaviour_monitoring_details = f.behaviour_monitoring_details
    CROSS JOIN most_frequent mf
    GROUP BY student_id
)
SELECT s.bio_data, s.student_details
FROM Students s
JOIN student_results sr ON s.student_id = sr.student_id
WHERE sr.total_records = sr.matching_records;

{"question": "Quels sont le nom du critique, le titre du film, la note du film et la date de la note pour chaque film, triés par nom du critique, par titre du film, puis enfin par note ?", "schema": "CREATE TABLE Movie(
	mID int primary key, 
	title text, 
	year int, 
	director text
);

CREATE TABLE Rating(
	rID int, 
	mID int, 
	stars int, 
	ratingDate date,
	FOREIGN KEY (mID) references Movie(mID),
	FOREIGN KEY (rID) references Reviewer(rID)
);

CREATE TABLE Reviewer(
	rID int primary key, 
	name text);"}

{"question": "Quels sont le nom du critique, le titre du film, la note du film et la date de la note pour chaque film, triés par nom du critique, par titre du film, puis enfin par note ?", "schema": "CREATE TABLE Movie(
	mID int primary key, 
	title text, 
	year int, 
	director text
);

CREATE TABLE Rating(
	rID int, 
	mID int, 
	stars int, 
	ratingDate date,
	FOREIGN KEY (mID) references Movie(mID),
	FOREIGN KEY (rID) references Reviewer(rID)
);

CREATE TABLE Reviewer(
	rID int primary key, 
	name text);"}
SELECT T3.name, T2.title, T1.stars, T1.ratingDate FROM Rating AS T1 JOIN Movie AS T2 ON T1.mID = T2.mID JOIN Reviewer AS T3 ON T1.rID = T3.rID ORDER BY T3.name, T2.title, T1.stars

{"question": "Trouvez le titre des livres commandés par le client Peter Doe mais pas par le client James Smith.", "schema": "CREATE TABLE Author
( idAuthor NUMBER PRIMARY KEY,
  Name VARCHAR(25));

CREATE TABLE Author_Book
(ISBN CHAR(15),
Author NUMBER,
CONSTRAINT al_PK PRIMARY KEY (ISBN, Author),
CONSTRAINT BookA_FK FOREIGN KEY (ISBN) REFERENCES `Book`(ISBN) on delete cascade,
CONSTRAINT Author_FK FOREIGN KEY (Author) REFERENCES `Author`(idAuthorA));

CREATE TABLE Book
(ISBN CHAR(15) PRIMARY KEY,
Title VARCHAR(60) NOT NULL,
Author CHAR(4) NOT NULL,
PurchasePrice NUMBER(6,2) DEFAULT 0,
SalePrice NUMBER(6,2) DEFAULT 0);

CREATE TABLE Books_Order(
ISBN CHAR(15),
IdOrder CHAR(10),
amount NUMBER(3) CHECK (amount >0),
CONSTRAINT lp_PK PRIMARY KEY (ISBN, idOrder),
CONSTRAINT Book_FK FOREIGN KEY (ISBN) REFERENCES `Book`(ISBN) on delete cascade,
CONSTRAINT pedido_FK FOREIGN KEY (IdOrder) REFERENCES `Orders`(IdOrder) on delete cascade);

CREATE TABLE Client
(IdClient CHAR(10) PRIMARY KEY,
 Name VARCHAR(25) NOT NULL,
 Address VARCHAR(60) NOT NULL,
 NumCC CHAR(16) NOT NULL);

CREATE TABLE Orders
(IdOrder CHAR(10) PRIMARY KEY,
 IdClient CHAR(10) NOT NULL REFERENCES Client on delete cascade,
 DateOrder DATE,
 DateExped DATE);"}

raw_output:
SELECT b.Title
FROM Book AS b
JOIN Books_Order AS bo ON b.ISBN = bo.ISBN
JOIN Orders AS o ON bo.IdOrder = o.IdOrder
JOIN Client AS c ON o.IdClient = c.IdClient
WHERE c.Name = 'Peter Doe'
  AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM Books_Order AS bo2
    JOIN Orders AS o2 ON bo2.IdOrder = o2.IdOrder
    JOIN Client AS c2 ON o2.IdClient = c2.IdClient
    WHERE bo2.ISBN = b.ISBN
      AND c2.Name = 'James Smith'
  );
clean_sql: SELECT b.Title FROM Book AS b JOIN Books_Order AS bo ON b.ISBN = bo.ISBN JOIN Orders AS o ON bo.IdOrder = o.IdOrder JOIN Client AS c ON o.IdClient = c.IdClient WHERE c.Name = 'Peter Doe' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM Books_Order AS bo2 JOIN Orders AS o2 ON bo2.IdOrder = o2.IdOrder JOIN Client AS c2 ON o2.IdClient = c2.IdClient WHERE bo2.ISBN = b.ISBN AND c2.Name = 'James Smith' )

{"question": "Quels sont le nom du critique, le titre du film, la note du film et la date de la note pour chaque film, triés par nom du critique, par titre du film, puis enfin par note ?", "schema": "CREATE TABLE Movie(
	mID int primary key, 
	title text, 
	year int, 
	director text
);

CREATE TABLE Rating(
	rID int, 
	mID int, 
	stars int, 
	ratingDate date,
	FOREIGN KEY (mID) references Movie(mID),
	FOREIGN KEY (rID) references Reviewer(rID)
);

CREATE TABLE Reviewer(
	rID int primary key, 
	name text);"}
SELECT T3.name, T2.title, T1.stars, T1.ratingDate FROM Rating AS T1 JOIN Movie AS T2 ON T1.mID = T2.mID JOIN Reviewer AS T3 ON T1.rID = T3.rID ORDER BY T3.name, T2.title, T1.stars

);

{"question": "Quels sont le nom du critique, le titre du film, la note du film et la date de la note pour chaque film, triés par nom du critique, par titre du film, puis enfin par note ?", "schema": "CREATE TABLE Movie(
	mID int primary key, 
	title text, 
	year int, 
	director text
);

CREATE TABLE Rating(
	rID int, 
	mID int, 
	stars int, 
	ratingDate date,
	FOREIGN KEY (mID) references Movie(mID),
	FOREIGN KEY (rID) references Reviewer(rID)
);

CREATE TABLE Reviewer(
	rID int primary key, 
	name text);"}
SELECT T3.name, T2.title, T1.stars, T1.ratingDate FROM Rating AS T1 JOIN Movie AS T2 ON T1.mID = T2.mID JOIN Reviewer AS T3 ON T1.rID = T3.rID ORDER BY T3.name, T2.title, T1.stars

CREATE TABLE "track" (

"Year_Opened" real,
PRIMARY KEY ("Track_ID")
);"}
SELECT count(*) FROM track

{"question": "Quels sont le nom du critique, le titre du film, la note du film et la date de la note pour chaque film, triés par nom du critique, par titre du film, puis enfin par note ?", "schema": "CREATE TABLE Movie(
	mID int primary key, 
	title text, 
	year int, 
	director text
);

CREATE TABLE Rating(
	rID int, 
	mID int, 
	stars int, 
	ratingDate date,
	FOREIGN KEY (mID) references Movie(mID),
	FOREIGN KEY (rID) references Reviewer(rID)
);

CREATE TABLE Reviewer(
	rID int primary key, 
	name text);"}
SELECT T3.name, T2.title, T1.stars, T1.ratingDate FROM Rating AS T1 JOIN Movie AS T2 ON T1.mID = T2.mID JOIN Reviewer AS T3 ON T1.rID = T3.rID ORDER BY T3.name, T2.title, T1.stars

{"question": "Combien de circuits avons-nous ?", "schema": "CREATE TABLE "race" (
"Race_ID" int,
"Name" text,
"Class" text,
"Date" text,
"Track_ID" text,
PRIMARY KEY ("Race_ID"),
FOREIGN KEY ("Track_ID") REFERENCES "track"("Track_ID")
);

CREATE TABLE "track" (
"Track_ID" int,
"Name" text,
"Location" text,
"Seating" real,
"Year_Opened" real,
PRIMARY KEY ("Track_ID")
);"}
SELECT count(*) FROM track

{"question": "Quels sont les 5 meilleurs livres en termes de montant des ventes ? Donne-moi leurs titres et leurs dates de sortie.", "schema": "CREATE TABLE "author" (
"Author_ID" int,
"Name" text,
"Age" int,
"Gender" text,
PRIMARY KEY ("Author_ID")
);

CREATE TABLE "book" (
"Book_ID" int,
"Title" text,
"Book_Series" text,
"Author_ID" int,
"Press_ID" int,
"Sale_Amount" text,
"Release_date" text,
PRIMARY KEY ("Book_ID"),
FOREIGN KEY (`Author_ID`) REFERENCES `author`(`Author_ID`),
FOREIGN KEY (`Press_ID`) REFERENCES `press`(`Press_ID`)
);

CREATE TABLE "press" (
"Press_ID" int,
"Name" text,
"Month_Profits_billion" real,
"Year_Profits_billion" real,
PRIMARY KEY ("Press_ID")
);"}

raw_output:
SELECT Book_Series
FROM book
GROUP BY Book_Series
HAVING MAX(CAST(Sale_Amount AS REAL)) > 1000
   AND MIN(CAST(Sale_Amount AS REAL)) < 500;
